test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'YOU' is coded as '20' and 'LIP' is coded as '44'. What is the code for 'ROB' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of position values of opposite letters according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'YOU' is coded as '20'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18c8c60e4d29cc811dc6701240abd015761fbcacd009a96cd3c5d1a7e60009c1.png] 

And, 

 
• 'LIP' is coded as '44'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3e9198410132ec6f257fdb637104cedfbc004aab009988679d78b635e6240e9.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'ROB' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3154794e60c69c73bf5a7ba9d5fb5053cf4373c58410ab78b25ad3ed2728f194.png] 

Hence, "46" is the correct answer.
